attributes.description: Overview of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint information gathering posture snapshots.

embeddableConfig.title: Events over Time by OS Platform

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides a view of information gathering posture snapshots from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Each record is a per-device TVM snapshot from the InfoGatheringExport API, including antivirus health and sensor status. It highlights outdated signatures and engines, trends over time by OS platform, and breakdowns by device group and host.

[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/microsoft_defender_endpoint/overview)
